answer: Prayers & Duties >> Jumuah & Eid Prayers Question ID: 43069 Country: India Title: No one to give Khutbah on Friday Question: What is the ruling if there is nobody to give sermon on the Friday in a masjid? Should the people sitting there offer regular Zuhr prayer in congregation or what is the ruling in this regard. Answer ID: 43069 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 137/119/B=1434) A person who could read a little recites two or four lines from the book of Khutbah it will suffice for Khutbah to be complete and Jumuah salah can be offered thereafter. If only surah fatiha is recited in Khutbah then too it shall be valid. There is no need to offer Zuhr salah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
